regression_findings.finding: Local destination edit during remote apply acquisition could be overwritten.
regression_findings.resolution: Destination and receipt revalidated after source acquisition and before replacement.
regression_findings.test: a local edit during apply's remote acquisition survives as a stale-plan rejection

regression_findings.finding: Reading a FIFO source could hang.
regression_findings.resolution: Reject special files before nonblocking open.
regression_findings.test: a FIFO source fails promptly without opening a blocking stream

regression_findings.finding: Source-control exclusion could hide user-added .git/.hg/.svn files in installed targets.
regression_findings.resolution: Exclude control internals only on source acquisition; target additions are observed and block mutation.

regression_findings.finding: Shared canonical home/project roots could duplicate inventory or write a project receipt into global state.
regression_findings.resolution: Deduplicate physical discovery roots; require explicit global scope for mutation from home; global receipts remain readable from other projects.

regression_findings.finding: A concurrent replacement during remove must not be overwritten by rollback or reported as success.
regression_findings.resolution: Preserve new user files and old backup with E_RECOVERY_REQUIRED and a persisted recovery path.
regression_findings.test: remove preserves concurrent replacement and its original backup with an explicit recovery diagnostic

regression_findings.finding: Update preview omitted resources removed from the candidate source.
regression_findings.resolution: Affected file list is the sorted union of current intact files and candidate files.
regression_findings.test: update preview includes a resource removed from its candidate snapshot
